title: The Best AirPods Cases We’ve Used In Our Day-to-Day Lives (2026)

claims.claim: The Dbrand Grip Case is made of black rubber and offers more than 40 skin options.

evidence.quote: The case is made of black rubber and can then be personalized with your choice of skins, plus an optional lanyard. There are more than 40 options, and you can swap them out whenever, though the sticker-like skins aren't reusable.

claims.claim: The UAG rugged case adds a thick layer of rubber around the original AirPods case and comes in 10 different color options.

evidence.quote: UAG is in the business of making tough accessories, and this sturdy option adds a thick layer of rubber around the original AirPods case to protect it from drops.
Every feature works as intended, and there are 10 different color options to choose from.

claims.claim: ESR's Orbit case comes with magnets that attach securely to a MagSafe charger.

evidence.quote: It comes with magnets that attach securely to a MagSafe charger.
if you're all in on MagSafe accessories, you'll love ESR’s Orbit case. It comes with magnets that attach securely to a MagSafe charger.

claims.claim: Alpaka x Twelve South Micro Tote is priced at $30 and made from Alpaka's durable X-Pac material.

evidence.quote: Alpaka x Twelve South Micro Tote ($30): What is it about cute tiny tote bags that drives people cuckoo bananas? Because I really want this limited-edition collaboration between two makers of high-quality accessories, Alpaka and Twelve South.
Made from Alpaka's durable X-Pac material, it includes a D-ring to hook onto the outside of your bag, belt loop, or keychain.

claims.claim: Bellroy Pod Jacket is priced at $39 and includes a corded lanyard.

evidence.quote: Bellroy Pod Jacket ($39): Sadly, it's time to replace my trusty Incase Woolenex AirPods Case because it's reached the end of its useful life; I am upgrading to the AirPods Pro 3; and Incase no longer makes this product.
It includes a corded lanyard, which I don't use since I prefer to keep it in my pocket, and the lanyard just gets in the way.
